name: bijaku1
about: bijaku (微弱, weak) 1: curve k = 1 of the eleven of Sec. 26 (October (2026)#Y-0NbRU, Fig. 0NNbp), the case of nijin, gamma_sigma = 23141/682840 g = 0.3389 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g; g2(P->0) = 0.8000), on the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits) (Fabrice, 15 Nov 2026: 'let's prepare a Psigma log series at small pumpings, until 0.5', 'with pilot to check convergence issues, not computing very nearby 0.3-0.4% off pumps and having 0.502 counting as 0.5; this should run together with the ongoing hokan, same priority, running in //'); the pumps of the case done already within 0.5 % stand for 5 of its points (0.177 by nijin's 0.178 g, 0.23 by nijin's 0.23 g, 0.298 by nijin's 0.298 g, 0.386 by nijin's 0.386 g, 0.5 by nijin's 0.502 g); first a pilot of 1 pump (0.001 g), then the series (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken, code/bijaku_pilot.py); code/bijaku_specs.py 1.0

parts.about: the pilot: the bottom of the series, 0.001 g, at orders 150 with weights, 200, 250, 300 and 400 at 80 digits and 300 at 160 digits: whether 150/200 (B), 250/300 (D) agree with 300/400 (E) there, and whether 80 digits hold; with hokan1's pilot pump 0.022 g and nijin's pilot pump 0.502 g it sets the orders of the series (code/bijaku_pilot.py --sakusen bijaku1)
